rule: The right-size-the-tooling triage gate suppresses heavy tooling only for trivial lookups; a structural / who-calls / impact task must still escalate to the heavy path (lead with codebase-memory-mcp for impact, ast-grep for code search) and must not be answered by a single plain grep.
prompt: I am about to change the signature of a function named `Send`. Before I do, find everywhere it is called across this codebase and tell me what would break.
expect: treats this as a structural / who-calls / impact task and escalates to the heavy path (codebase-memory-mcp graph tools, or ast-grep) per the tool precedence
leads with the structural tool for the impact analysis rather than a single regex grep
expect_not: answers a who-calls / impact question with a plain regex grep over source as the primary strategy
treats this multi-file impact task as a trivial lookup and skips structural tooling
